opening.argument: The video explains a rewards-program update through concrete uses of points, not a request for sensitive information or an investment. It describes points earned through purchases as value for further purchases, then says those points can be used for treatments, including brow shaping and a cut and color. The description also expressly discloses that the shopping and referral links may earn the creator a small commission when viewers purchase through them. That disclosure makes the commercial connection visible. On the supplied evidence, this is an ordinary discussion of loyalty benefits and affiliate links; it does not show deceptive payment, credential, or investment solicitation.
